create_dummy_server: create a DummyServer instance for debugging and testing inference pipelines
start_dummy_server: start a dummy HTTP server on localhost that responds to /v1/chat/completions with sample text
test_dummy_server_health: test the dummy server health monitoring by checking if the HTTP server is running
run_dummy_server_cleanup: run server cleanup to gracefully shut down the dummy HTTP server in a daemon thread
review_dummy_handler: review the DummyHandler class that handles POST /v1/chat/completions and GET /v1/models requests
